summary: Backend: 36/38 pytest passed (1 skipped - check-in time window conditional, 1 real bug: PUT /api/resources/{id} returns 500). All core flows verified: auth (admin/manager/employee), resource list w/ policies, booking validate/create/approve/reject/cancel/checkin/extend, QR code gating, role enforcement (403), parking capacity, maintenance preview+apply cascading cancellations, reports overview (admin+manager, 403 for employee), calendar endpoints. Frontend: login page, demo accounts visible, employee & admin logins both redirect correctly. Role-gated sidebar works (admin sees Manager/Admin sections; employee doesn't). Dashboard/Browse Resources/Operations dashboard render correctly with data.

critical.issue: Returns 500. RCA: routers/resources_routes.py update_resource does setattr(r, 'type', v) where v is a raw str from body, overwriting the enum column. Subsequent _to_out() does r.type.value -> AttributeError 'str' object has no attribute 'value'. Fix: cast to ResourceType enum (e.g., setattr(r,'type',ResourceType(v))) or use Pydantic validator.

minor.issue: When non-approval resource is booked by a user whose BRS<85, booking goes to pending_approval instead of approved. If this is intentional, ensure UI surfaces it clearly; if not, tweak auto_approve rule.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> (can cause hydration errors)

action_items: Fix PUT /api/resources/{id} 500 — coerce type string -> ResourceType enum in update_resource (and also in create_resource for consistency).
Decide behavior for low-BRS users on non-approval resources (current: pending_approval). If desired, document it; otherwise let auto-approve proceed when resource doesn't require approval.
Clean up the <span> children inside <option> in BrowseResources.jsx to avoid React hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/resources_routes.py: update_resource blindly setattrs body dict onto SQLAlchemy model; raw string overwrites Enum column -> 500 on read. Add field-by-field serialization or use ResourceType(value).
services.py auto_approve rule also requires BRS>=85 even when resource.requires_approval is False — this may surprise users (their own hot desk booking becomes pending). Review policy.

bookings_routes.py cancel flow increments owner.cancelled_count and recomputes BRS whenever owner cancels — makes end-to-end test suites degrade BRS quickly. Consider penalizing only late cancellations.
CORS middleware: allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=False is fine, but DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET are committed to .env; rotate before production.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login; auth_testing.md playbook requires lockout after 5 failures.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed bookings & one TEST_AutoResource per run using random day+minute offsets to avoid collisions; no manual cleanup (soft-deleted resources + cancelled bookings remain in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. The suite uses random day (0-15) + minute offsets within 30-day policy; parking test hard-codes day=1 (max_advance=14). After main agent fixes resource update bug, re-run that single test. Frontend was only smoke tested—deeper playwright coverage of booking form validation panel, approval queue, QR panel, check-in modal, maintenance dialog, policy editor, reports charts, floor map, calendars still recommended.
rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/resources/{id} 500: In routers/resources_routes.py update_resource, `for k,v in data.items(): setattr(r,k,v)` overwrites r.type (Enum column) with a plain string; when _to_out() then accesses r.type.value, SQLAlchemy has not re-coerced it, so Python raises AttributeError. Reproduce by PUT-ing any valid ResourceIn payload to an existing resource as admin. Mitigation: either pop `type` and call `r.type = ResourceType(data['type'])`, or refresh(r) from DB before serializing so Enum coercion re-applies.
